collapsible
FAQ / collapsible details list built on native <details><summary> with zero JavaScript and an animated chevron.



collapsible
How do I install the Pulse tracking SDK?
Add the JavaScript snippet to your site's <head>, or install via npm with npm i @pulse/analytics. Initialize with your project's write key from Settings → API Keys. Events appear in the Live Stream within seconds.
What is the difference between an event and a property?
An event is something a user does (e.g. Order Completed). A property is metadata attached to that event (e.g. revenue: 49.00) or to the user profile (e.g. plan: Enterprise). Use properties to filter and break down your charts.
How long is event data retained?
Starter retains 6 months, Growth retains 24 months, and Enterprise retains unlimited history. Raw event export to your warehouse is available on Growth and above.
Can I import historical data?
Yes. Use the batch import API or upload a CSV under Data → Import. Timestamps in the past are accepted, so backfilled events land in the correct cohort.
